typecheck.changed: run=false; for file in {files}; do case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|package.json|package-lock.json|tsconfig.json) run=true ;; esac; done; if $run; then npm run typecheck; fi

test.changed: run_node=false; run_bats=false; for file in {files}; do case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|package.json|package-lock.json|tsconfig.json) run_node=true ;; core/ai/claude-box/*|Brewfile) run_bats=true ;; esac; done; status=0; if $run_node; then node --test extra/scripts/*.test.ts || status=$?; fi; if $run_bats; then PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH core/ai/claude-box/test/run.sh || status=$?; fi; exit "$status"
